page_title: SHU 2-3 LUT | Sheffield Utd v Luton 26/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+9' Ross Barkley (Luton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Samuel Allison blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Sheffield Utd.
90+6' Dangerous play by Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd). Samuel Allison blows his whistle for a foul. Luton have been awarded a free kick.
90+4' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+3' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+3' Sheffield Utd spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. The referee blows his whistle, Sheffield Utd are awarded a corner kick.

90+1' Chance! Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from George Baldock, but his shot from inside the box flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
88' A dangerous looking corner kick from Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is cleared to safety by the defence.

88' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save. The ball goes out of play. Sheffield Utd are awarded a corner kick.
87' The corner is swung in but Sheffield Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' A substitution has been made. Vini Souza goes off and Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
86' Cameron Archer will be replaced by William Osula (Sheffield Utd).
86' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Jack Robinson is replaced by Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd).
86' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) replacing Andros Townsend.
81' 2 - 3 OWN GOAL! Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 2:3.
81' Ross Barkley (Luton) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
79' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Allison had an easy-decision to make.
78' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
78' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) replaces Alfie Doughty.
77' 2 - 2 Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) is totally disorientated and accidentally puts the ball into his own goal!
77' There's an opportunity for Alfie Doughty (Luton) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
77' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Luton have a corner.
72' It is time for a substitution. Anis Ben Slimane (Sheffield Utd) is on for Gustavo Hamer.
72' Here is a change. Ryan Giles is going off and Rob Edwards gives the last tactical orders to Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton).
71' That will be all from Elijah Adebayo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Carlton Morris (Luton).
71' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Sheffield Utd players have a reason to celebrate!
71' The Sheffield Utd players halt their celebrations as referee Samuel Allison makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
69' 2 - 1 Goal! Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
68' Amari'i Bell (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Wesley Foderingham comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' Sheffield Utd players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
65' Alfie Doughty (Luton) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
64' Samuel Allison blows his whistle after Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Luton in a dangerous position.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! James McAtee plays a simple square pass into the feet of Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:1.

60' Andros Townsend (Luton) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.

58' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) and James McAtee attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable reflex save to deny a rebound from George Baldock (Sheffield Utd)! That was a huge opportunity!

56' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
52' Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
51' Ryan Giles (Luton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
51' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Allison blows his whistle for a foul.
49' The resulting corner from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) comes to nothing.

48' Oliver McBurnie receives a sweet cross inside the box from George Baldock (Sheffield Utd), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play and Sheffield Utd manage to earn a corner.
46' Andre Brooks comes off the pitch to be replaced by Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Samuel Allison blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' CHANCE! Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
45+1' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45+1' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Andros Townsend (Luton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

43' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Andros Townsend (Luton) is going to have a crack himself.
42' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) brings an opponent down and Samuel Allison interrupts the game. A free kick to Luton.
41' What was Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

39' Ross Barkley (Luton) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
39' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner.

38' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Alfie Doughty (Luton). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out for a corner. Luton can continue in their attacking effort.
37' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
35' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wesley Foderingham, who smothers the ball.
32' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

31' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the set piece, took a good first touch and unleashed a mid-range projectile to the right side of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski makes a nice save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sheffield Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Gabriel Osho (Luton) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Sheffield Utd have a free kick.
28' A pass by Alfie Doughty (Luton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
27' A spell of possession for Luton in an attempt to control the game.
26' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ross Barkley (Luton). Samuel Allison saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
25' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends a cross in and finds Oliver McBurnie inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
24' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
24' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Sheffield Utd win a corner.

23' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Wesley Foderingham makes a comfortable save.
20' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

20' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sheffield Utd are going to take it.
17' 0 - 1 Alfie Doughty (Luton) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Wesley Foderingham with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
17' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
16' Ross Barkley (Luton) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
16' Alfie Doughty (Luton) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
14' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
12' Sheffield Utd can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
11' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Sheffield Utd will take a corner kick.
9' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
9' The ball is cleared after Elijah Adebayo (Luton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Luton will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
6' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

5' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Luton as they win a corner.
4' The cross into the penalty area from Alfie Doughty (Luton) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
2' Some great controlled play and passing from Luton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Luton will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Samuel Allison.
